 ▸ Kiro CLI 3.0 launches at the end of October. If you have auto-updates on, you'll be upgraded to 3.0 automatically.
   It brings Approve for me, cloud sessions, memory, workflows, local sandbox, an improved trust model, expanded hooks
   and specs.
   Note: 3.0 doesn't support the legacy --classic experience and the legacy desktop app.
